column1: # Gain applied per file when swapping in the 2026-10-22 MiniMax re-delivery.
# The new masters were deliberately left quiet (voice peaks ~-14 dBFS, one-shots
# ~-20 dBFS), which would drop them ~10 dB under the shipped mix. Each value is
# `old_peak_dBFS - new_peak_dBFS`, so the in-engine volume table keeps working
# unchanged and only the source content / bitrate changes.
